notes.title: Petrified Pawns - What's Next - Update 2.0 Roguelite Rework
notes.notes:
Maps reworkA lot of maps will be scrapped and instead completely new maps that are large but segmented into smaller fights will be added. 
You fight one small chessboard at a time and when the board is cleared you get to choose a path. You can see all the enemies in the next encounters so you can make wise decisions. The map layout has a degree of randomness to it and the encounters and obstacles you face are random each play-through as well. Making the game more re-playable.

New map structure: 

Act 1

Boss Fight

Act 2 ,

Boss Fight

Act 3 

Final Boss

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193899/f4e67c53e1576d50a176aa53666d2c8ca655ec0f.png"]
ItemsAll items have been replaced. 
A new equipment slot has been added: Each unit can equip a weapon and a armor piece which can increase the strength further. The weapons are now more unique, have different stats and might alter your play-style.

For Example:

Twin Strike: Hits the target twice every swing (Making strength more valuable)

Great Axe: Deals a lot of damage but has a 1 turn cooldown on its swing.

Double Edged Sword: Deals damage back to you each swing.

Expensive Sword: Has a negative effect which makes every time the unit moves cost gold.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193899/956f5a9dcbd0bc461d6608078d6b0dafb1342060.png"]
RelicsInstead of a talent tree menu there are now relic items that can be found in the world.
The relics work as upgrades to some or all of your units giving them more strength, critical strike or health. Relics can also grant you a new player spell to cast. Merchants, a new unit, sells relics as well as weapons and potions.
Units
New chess piece behaviour:

Cannon can now rotate towards a target and when it fires it damages all targets in front of it.

Pawns can equip a spear which doubles their attack range.

Dragon eggs can now hatch after a few turns and turn into a Cobra unit.

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Infinity Mode:

Increased camera movement range.
Adds can now spawn with bosses. More the further you get.
Multiple bosses can now spawn at the same time. Wave 50+.


Standard Mode:

Removed the Gauntlet level. 
Added more treasure chests on a few levels.

notes.title: Patch notes for update version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Boss difficulty increase

 Dire bear boss is now larger and takes up 4 tiles like other bosses and has gotten more health.
 Dragon's breath deals more damage and set its targets on fire. The dragons melee attacks is more limited, only in front.
Fixed broken units
[olist]
 Cannon can now fire again.
 Witch's totems can now fire again.
[/olist]Fixed broken talents
Shield Wall no longer stack, which was never intended.
Improved framerate
The highest quality setting is no longer rendering a unnecessarily large resolution.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Turn duration, tooltips & teleports
notes.notes:
Tooltips

 Holding down the control button will show all units equipment tool-tips above their heads when the equipment menus are open. Useful when you don't know if the item your dragging is better than the one that's already equipped.
 The equipment icons above the chess pieces heads now show the rarity color of the item.

Mass Teleporters
Added teleporters to a couple of maps to make it less tedious to move up all your units.

Elixirs

 Increased the drop rate of speed potions.
 Removed healing crit potion from the loot table, it wasn't impactful. 

Item Stats
All legendary items now gives +1 to movement range.

Turn Delay Fix
Sped up the time it takes before u can move again. Larger maps used to slow down the turns, the limitation has now been removed.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Small adjustments
notes.notes:
New language added: German
Game is playable in English, Portuguese, Swedish and now also German!

Balance Changes
[olist]
 You can no longer buy the same talent multiple times (except the bottom row with chess pieces, potions and weapons). The issue was being able to stack multiple Axe Specialization talents, each giving 10% damage increase would do way to much damage.

 The knight chess piece now deal more damage because it's more finicky to target opponents with. Bishop and rook now deal less damage.

 Reduced the move range of warlocks and archers
[/olist]

Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the knight would end the players turn twice.

 Fixed a bug that would increase the turns duration before you could move again.

 Fixed platforms in infinity mode sometimes not spawning after clearing a wave.

 Fixed platforms getting stuck up in the air in infinity mode.
[/olist]

Other
The valid tile a player can move to now refreshes more often. When a unit dies or takes damage the possible tiles you can move to might change.

notes.title: Save System Patch
notes.notes:
Patched the saving system - You can now resume a saved game
Fixed an issue where you would lose your inventory, talents and equipment when relaunching the game.

  You can now resume play on the level you reached last played. But you will start at the beginning of the level with the units, items and spells you had when you got there. Saving only happens when you load a new level. If you played prior to this patch your save file is no longer valid I'm afraid and you'll have to start at the beginning.

 Fixed the options menu not always saving the settings.

 Nerfed the speed boosts. You can now only gain +1 movement range per item. +1 from barrels, +1 from speed potions, 1+ from equipped weapon.

 Infinity mode will no longer start with items you had in standard mode.

notes.title: Developer Update - Leaning in to the Strategy Aspect
notes.notes:
Seeing players try the demo during next fest has giving a lot of valuable feedback so I've made a couple of adjustments to the game.

The order of Turn-Based Movement and Attacks
More Strategic
Players expected the chess pieces to behave a certain way and to be able to avoid taking damage so... The turn sequence has changed so your now able to step away from tiles where you would have taken damage. Works like this:
[olist]
Player makes a move
Player units attack
Enemy units attack (this moved up)
Enemy units move (this moved down)
Bosses move
Traps trigger
[/olist]

So now the enemy won't move and instantly attack you, you can plan ahead and completely avoid taking damage.

Chess Pieces
The Knight Attack Pattern
During the demo the knight could jump in an L-shaped pattern but would attack any units close to it. This made it impossible to play around since you'd always take damage. Now the knight will attack in the same L-shaped pattern which will give it longer range and playing with and against a knight will require a bit more thought.

Steam Achievements
Added achievements.

Steam Leader-boards
There was already a high-score panel and now a leader-board is added. Enabling you to compare your score both globally and between friends.

notes.title: Major Demo Update - 3 Weeks to Release
notes.notes:
New playable units

 The Crossbow: A ranged unit who shoots arrows from distance.
 The Warlock: A caster who fires off fireballs from distance.

New maps 
The demo now consists of the first 5 levels of the full game. 
It starts with a tutorial and then ramps up in difficulty

 The Beginning, a tutorial level to learn the most basic mechanic. Selecting, moving, gaining mana, healing and equipping items.
 The Old Town. A level with many basic enemies but not necessarily a cake walk.
 The Quarry. Introducing more ranged enemies. Defeat the king at the top of the quarry.
 The Gauntlet. You need to make your way through a large number of ranged enemies. Some standing on platforms you cant get to unless you have a character that can jump over the ledges. Reach the elevator with your king and any other units you want. When the elevator leaves any units left behind will die.
 The Trap. You find yourself stuck in a small room. There's a lever that will open the gate but more and more enemies keeps entering. How long can you survive?

Power ups
Talent tree
Added a talent tree menu where you can now purchase power-ups and extra abilities.

Gold
Treasure chests now drop gold and there are there are also bags with gold coins scattered throughout the world.

Random bonus rewards for choosing different chess pieces to add. 
When you choose between chess pieces to add to your group they sometimes have a small bonus effect that makes all your units stronger. 
For example:

 Axe Specialization: Increases the damage done by units wearing axes.
 Mana Thirst: Gain mana when killing an enemy.

Added more weapons with more flavours. 
For example:

 Cleave attacks: Sometimes damages an extra nearby unit.
 Berserking: Deal more damage when you're low on health.
 Execute: Deal more damage when the opponent is low on health.
 Lifesteal: When a unit hits a critical strike the unit heals itself.
 Diagonal strikes: deal more damage to opponents standing in tiles diagonal to the attacker.


High-score
When all the levels have been completed you get a score. Collecting treasures, looting gold and killing enemies grant you a higher score. Dying and taking too many turns reduces your score.

Other

 Refined movement and character rotation when going up and down ramps.
 More settings for camera. Adjust camera movement speed, zoom speed. Hide the green visual squares for where a unit can move.

notes.title: New demo update with different maps to play!
notes.notes:
Updated the movement to be faster and more responsive.

Attacks are also faster and more consistent and your now able to instantly deal a killing blow to a low health opponent that has less health than your unit has strength. You can do so by moving your unit to a tile with a yellow highlight.

There are 5 new levels in this demo each with a boss at the end.

New intractable objects are placed in the world: Crate, Barrel, Vase and Treasure Chests. Each type give different buffs or rewards.

Replaced some of the healing spells for more interactive and fun versions. They cost mana so you cant use them too much but you can regain mana by breaking barrels and vases f.ex.

Added a save system. When you advance to the next map the game automatically gets saved.

Added a key bind menu where u can rebind abilities to new keys.
